scope: Intrinsic owned keyword abilities, not all free-text effects or reference annotations.
rules: Owned release tags establish baseline keyword ownership. ReferencedTag never confers ownership by itself.
AURA and TRIGGER_VISUAL engine markers are not standalone gameplay abilities.
Discover on OG_311 is in its own release text even before its dedicated later tag.
OG_045 grants Deathrattle; OG_080e grants Stealth; OG_081 destroys frozen minions. None owns those referenced keywords.
OG_026 unlocks overloaded crystals but is not itself Overload.
OG_044 modifies Choose One cards but is not itself Choose One.
OG_209 grants Lifesteal to spells, not to itself. It gains its own Spell Damage in 27.2.
OG_150 and OG_218 lose the displayed Enraged keyword in 11.0, retaining explicitly worded effects.
OG_044a changes Charge to Rush in 20.0. OG_188 and OG_334 gain Taunt in 27.2.
OG_340 switches the two targeting-immunity descriptors to the formal Elusive keyword in 29.0.
Temporary absent implementation tags do not remove an unchanged printed owned keyword.
